Check Edvin docs and Shelf for special handling


Flexible ticket

The system detects if a Flexible Ticket Product is available. If it exists and hasn’t been used, you’ll be asked to check whether it applies based on the customer’s request and the Flexible Ticket terms & conditions.

If there’s no valid Flexible Ticket, you won’t see any related information.


Against Self-Transfer Guarantee

This option should be selected only when the Self-Transfer Guarantee is applicable and the customer wants to use it. If the customer wishes a voluntary rebooking in a VI order you should select "Voluntary"
